bio: This charming spot just steps from Fort Greene Park has an inviting tropical ambience and an even more enticing menu. Showcasing dishes from northern and southern Thailand, Glin Thai Bistro is the real deal, with unique offerings using high quality ingredients, all with a distinctively Thai look and feel. Begin with an order of gui chai, or crispy, golden-fried chive pancakes that balance sweet and savory. Fried rice studded with crabmeat, egg, and vegetables is ramped up with cilantro chili lime sauce and chili fish sauce, while the kra pow nuer, or 24-hour braised short ribs, will linger in your memory for their caramelized crust and fork-tender meat....
